parameters.formDescription: Paste a YouTube URL to identify strong moments and render captioned vertical clips. Only process videos you own or have permission to reuse.

nodes.name: Download, Analyze and Render Clips
nodes.notes: Requires the companion API service from the ZIP. For Docker Desktop on Windows, host.docker.internal resolves to the host. If n8n and the API run in the same Compose network, replace the host with the API service name.
